description: Replay the chronological trajectory of a session: 'full' returns all turns, 'selective' filters by min_importance/turn_types, 'progressive' keeps the most recent turns within token_budget, and 'hybrid' combines earlier high-salience anchor turns (up to 30% of token_budget) with the most recent turns.

current_session_id.description: Optional active session ID to exclude when selecting a prior session automatically

include_superseded.description: Also return turns replaced via supersedes (default false).

since.description: Time-range floor: epoch seconds, RFC 3339, or YYYY-MM-DD

track.description: Optional track slug to select the most recent prior session on this track

turn_types.description: Selective/hybrid mode: turn types to keep

until.description: Time-range ceiling: epoch seconds, RFC 3339, or YYYY-MM-DD

name: session.replay
title: Replay Session
